use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

use RGB = (red: ubyte, green: ubyte, blue: ubyte)

pt(x: double, y: double) -> (x: double, y: double) => (x = x, y = y)

scene() -> IMAGE is
    let image = IMAGE(160, 120)

    for y in 0..80 do
        let t = cast double(y) / 80.0D

        image.colour(
            cast ubyte(40.0D + 200.0D * t),
            cast ubyte(70.0D + 100.0D * t),
            cast ubyte(160.0D - 60.0D * t))
        image.fill_rectangle(
            0.0D, cast double(y), 160.0D, cast double(y + 1))
    od

    image.colour(255ub, 220ub, 60ub)
    image.disc(112.0D, 42.0D, 15.0D)

    image.colour(90ub, 60ub, 120ub)
    image.fill([pt(0.0D, 80.0D), pt(45.0D, 30.0D), pt(95.0D, 80.0D)])

    image.colour(60ub, 110ub, 70ub)
    image.fill([pt(55.0D, 80.0D), pt(105.0D, 48.0D), pt(160.0D, 80.0D)])

    image.colour(70ub, 150ub, 60ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(0.0D, 80.0D, 160.0D, 120.0D)

    image.colour(200ub, 35ub, 40ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(22.0D, 88.0D, 52.0D, 110.0D)

    image.colour(120ub, 25ub, 30ub)
    image.fill([pt(18.0D, 88.0D), pt(37.0D, 75.0D), pt(56.0D, 88.0D)])

    image.colour(250ub, 245ub, 235ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(33.0D, 97.0D, 41.0D, 110.0D)

    image
si

median_filter(source: IMAGE) -> IMAGE is
    let result = IMAGE(source.width, source.height)

    for y in 0..source.height do
        for x in 0..source.width do
            let window =
                (-1::1)
                    |> flat_map(dy => (-1::1) |> map(dx => (dx, dy)))
                    |> map(((dx, dy)) =>
                        source.pixel(
                            Math.clamp(x + dx, 0, source.width - 1),
                            Math.clamp(y + dy, 0, source.height - 1)))
                    |> collect_list()

            let middle = (pick: RGB -> ubyte) =>
                let sorted =
                    window |> map(pick) |> sort((a, b) => a <> b) in
                (sorted |> collect_list())[4]

            result.set_pixel(
                x, y,
                middle(p => p.red),
                middle(p => p.green),
                middle(p => p.blue))
        od
    od

    result
si

let random = System.Random(3)
let noisy = scene()

for _ in 0..1500 do
    let shade = if random.next(2) == 0 then 0ub else 255ub fi

    let x = random.next(noisy.width), y = random.next(noisy.height)

    noisy.set_pixel(x, y, shade, shade, shade)
od

noisy.write("noisy.png")

let source = IMAGE.read("noisy.png")
let cleaned = median_filter(source)

cleaned.write("cleaned.png")

write_line("1500 pixels of salt and pepper, then a 3 x 3 median filter")

source.show("noisy.png")
cleaned.show("cleaned.png")
